test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

My neighbour is / an young businessman / who is very friendly / with everyone.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'an young businessman'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'young businessman' **should be used instead of **'an young businessman'.**
 
• Here in the given sentence, the indefinite article **'a'** should be used because 'young' starts with a consonant sound. 
 
 
• *Example: Uranium is **a** toxic metal.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct Sentence:__** *My neighbour is** a young businessman** who is very friendly with everyone.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• No article is used before the possessive case of the proper noun. 

 
 
• *Example:*

 
 
• *The Sukhdev's bike is blue with an orange seat. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
• *Sukhdev's bike is blue with an orange seat. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​*​​But when there is a possessive case of a common noun, then, the article can be used before it. 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *The Woman's Yoga Book. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *
 
• *Woman's Yoga Book. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहां **'an young businessman'** के स्थान पर **'young businessman'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• यहाँ दिए गए वाक्य में, अनिश्चितकालीन **article **'**a**' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए क्योंकि '**young**' का प्रारम्भ **consonant sound** से होता है।
 
 
• *Example: Uranium is **a** toxic metal.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।
